pages.title: It's Alive
pages.text: Made from the flesh of a pig possessed by an Afrit, this chalk possesses$(br) both animalistic properties and part of an Afrit's power.$(br)

Some occultists have reported that the demonic flesh keeps the chalk alive,$(br) resulting in strange movements. However, this has never been officially$(br) documented or proven, remaining merely rumors that may or may not be $()
To obtain the $(item)Demonic Meat$() for $(item)Pink Chalk$() you need to$(br) $(l:possession_rituals/possess_zombie_piglin)summon and kill a Possessed Zombified Piglin$(/l)$(br)
